# Traffic (generated, do not edit)

Read 2026-11-20T09:00 UTC from Cloudflare's edge analytics for freshcalendars.com, last 7 days (UTC days). Every page the edge served to a real browser counts, so these numbers are higher than Google Analytics, which misses ad-blocked visits and readers who leave before the page finishes loading. Self-declared bots are left out; unlabeled bots are not, and they are many: real search traffic is mostly mobile, so a desktop share far above half means bots and crawlers inflate these totals. Treat them as an upper bound and use the trend and the story ranking. Source: `scripts/news-traffic.mjs`, daily.
